issues.title: Thin content
issues.howToFix: Either expand the page with genuinely useful content, noindex it, or consolidate it into a stronger page. If the content exists but is rendered by JavaScript, ensure it is server-rendered or pre-rendered.

decision: Accept 80-word tools navigation hub warning with one real tool. No broken/metadata/canonical issue reported; do not pad or noindex a useful hub merely to clear a word-count warning. HTML crawl precedes final JavaScript-only Clear-state fix.
